runway.name: Canonical roadmap
runway.description: Complete: the permanent Markdown/JSON roadmap, evidence method, definition of done, and God View links are merged and verified.

runway.name: Executable inventory
runway.description: Classify all scripts, tools, tests, workflows, inputs, outputs, network calls, and writes.

runway.name: Fixture validation
runway.description: Pass the complete fixture-only pipeline on current main.

runway.name: Live adapter
runway.description: Verify one allowlisted live source read-only.

runway.name: Controlled dry run
runway.description: Run source to review package with isolated artifacts and no forbidden writes.

runway.name: Review and disposition
runway.description: Create the actual package, stable selection, validation, disposition, and decision trace.

runway.name: Isolated staging
runway.description: Build and diff a production-shaped staging feed from approved records only.

runway.name: Production canary
runway.description: Publish a minimal canary and verify feeds, map behavior, and rollback.

runway.name: Scheduled operations
runway.description: Authorize recurring runs, freshness checks, monitoring, and alerts.

runway.name: Final closeout
runway.description: Complete runbooks, ownership, public status, blockers, and evidence audit.
